To add a colour: add an entry below and create the matching folder.
To add more shots of a colour: drop 2.jpg, 3.jpg ... into its folder.
price is in PENCE and lives on the product. A colour's optional price is
an OVERRIDE that must be lower — it drives 'Selected colours from £x'.
swatch is required. Leave it out and the sync refuses to write, but
prints a colour sampled from the photo as a starting suggestion — check
it against the garment before pasting it in, the sampler is rough.

products.name: Custom Fit Linen Shirt
products.description: Cut from a breathable pure linen that softens with every wear. A relaxed collar and a single chest pocket keep it easy — the shirt for long lunches and longer evenings.

products.name: Plain Short Sleeve Shirt
products.description: A plain-woven short sleeve shirt with a clean, unfussy line. No logo, no hardware — just a well-cut collar and a hem that sits right untucked.

products.name: 22.5 cm Classic Cotton Shorts
products.description: A 22.5 cm inseam in a garment-dyed cotton twill that holds its colour. Slanted hip pockets, a flat front, and enough room to actually sit down in.

products.name: Casual Polo Shirt
products.description: An everyday layer in a soft brushed cotton. Wear it open over a tee or buttoned on its own — it takes a crease well and loses it just as easily.
